top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks form a mature, experimentally verified achievement with a clear originating idea (trapping neutral atoms at the magic wavelength, Katori) and its realisation to the 10^-18 level (Ye), reproduced independently across species and laboratories. The two-laureate allocation and the citation scope are well defined and defensible, and every committee member already supports it, so awarding it is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Kroll is an atomic physicist at Lund but no documented connection to Katori or Ye
